description: This file defines the main React component 'App' for a note-taking web application. It manages state for notes, handles loading notes from an API, and renders the UI including a form, list, and refresh button.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches notes from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: handleSaved
methods.description: Handles the event when a new note is saved, updating the notes list.
